title: An email is a centred column on a desktop and full width on a phone

source.ref: owner 2026-10-20: the web email keeps a centre column and the phone gets full width; PROG-EMAIL1

detail: Built 2026-10-20 from a phone screenshot of the Vera brief in Gmail on Android: the card sat inside grey gutters and an inset border. The outer cell now has no side gutter, the phone rules square the card (no radius, side borders or shadow) and the hero, on all three shells (lib/email.ts, lib/email-react/shell.tsx, lib/email-studio/shell.ts). docs/EMAIL-LAYOUT.md section 1 states the rule.

verify.note: PASS 2026-10-20: the outer cell carries no side gutter and the phone rules square the card and hero on the shared shell and the studio shell; lib/email-shell-phone.test.ts pins both. A client that drops the style block still gets the full-width card because the gutter is gone from the inline style.
